name: Smart Drone for Bastar Forest Fire Detection
proposed_concept: Autonomous quadcopter drone patrolling forest canopies with thermal cameras to spot early leaf-litter fires.
rejection_reasons: Severe regulatory and security friction: Bastar is designated as a sensitive security corridor with stringent DGCA and local police airspace restrictions on UAV flights.
Unrealistic student budget: Reliable long-endurance autonomous thermal drones cost >₹1.5 - ₹3 Lakhs, far exceeding student prototype feasibility.
High operational vulnerability: Canopy density in Sal forests obscures thermal ground signatures; maintenance in rural Bastar lacks spare motor/esc supply chains.

name: Blockchain-Enabled Mahua Supply Chain Traceability Platform
proposed_concept: Ethereum/Polygon smart contract ledger tracking Mahua collection from tribal gatherer to organic distillery.
rejection_reasons: No physical prototype or hardware defensibility: Fails the requirement of building and physically demonstrating a hardware/physical prototype.
Gross mismatch with ground reality: Bastar forest gatherers lack smartphones, cellular connectivity, and digital literacy; smart contracts cannot verify whether Mahua was harvested hygienically.
Solves a non-critical symptom: The real economic loss occurs due to ground contamination and fungal rot, not lack of blockchain hashes.

name: Solar-Powered E-Rickshaw Retrofit Kit with Swappable Battery
proposed_concept: Conversion kit converting manual cycle rickshaws or petrol autos into solar-assisted electric vehicles with swappable LFP battery packs.
rejection_reasons: Prohibitive regulatory certification: Automotive homologation under CMVR (ARAI / ICAT) costs ₹15-30 Lakhs and takes 12-18 months, impossible for an engineering student prototype.
Capital intensity: Battery pack assembly and testing requires heavy capex, thermal testing chambers, and significant liability risk.
Crowded market with heavily funded incumbents: Startups like Altigreen, Euler Motors, and local unorganized Chinese retrofitters already dominate price-sensitive Tier-2/3 auto markets.

name: AI Voice Chatbot App for Tribal Tele-Medicine
proposed_concept: Mobile app using conversational LLMs fine-tuned on Gondi/Halbi to give medical advice to villagers.
rejection_reasons: Dangerous clinical hallucinations: Large language models fine-tuned on low-resource tribal dialects risk generating fatal diagnostic errors in acute conditions (snakebite, cerebral malaria).
Lack of physical diagnostic capability: Advice without physical biological testing (turbidity, bilirubin, temperature, blood count) leaves doctors unable to prescribe treatments.
Unmonetizable business model: Tribal patients cannot pay subscription fees, and state health departments do not procure uncertified diagnostic chatbots.

name: Smart IoT Waste Bin with Automated Sensor Lid & GSM Overflow Alert
proposed_concept: Ultrasonic sensor mounted on dustbin lid with servo motor opening and GSM SMS alerts to municipal sweepers.
rejection_reasons: Classic college hackathon cliché: One of the most overused, generic student projects; instantly rejected by serious venture investors and national judges.

Zero municipal procurement traction: Municipalities (like Jagdalpur Nagar Nigam) suffer from lack of basic waste processing infrastructure, not bin-lid automation; ultrasonic sensors get covered in grease/dirt within 2 days.
Negative unit economics: Adding ₹3,000 electronics to a ₹500 plastic bin creates vandalism and battery theft without generating revenue.
